messages.BoundedUIX.Name: Bounded UIX
messages.BoundedUIX.Description: This mod makes UIX elements selectable and editable with the usual Slot gizmos. Additionally, it fixes UIX elements breaking when a parent is inserted and allows debugging their preferred area.
messages.BoundedUIX.DevToolSelectableUIX.Name: DevTool-Selectable UIX
messages.BoundedUIX.DevToolSelectableUIX.Descript: Allows selecting UIX RectTransform elements directly with a DevTool. Uses the Selectable UIX settings.
messages.BoundedUIX.UIXGizmos.Name: UIX Gizmos
messages.BoundedUIX.UIXGizmos.Description: Modifies the various DevTool gizmos to work with UIX RectTransform elements.
messages.BoundedUIX.SlotAddingPatches.Name: Slot Adding Tweaks
messages.BoundedUIX.SlotAddingPatches.Description: Ensures that the UIX RectTransform hierarchy isn't broken when inserting slots using the inspector. Uses the Inspector settings.
messages.BoundedUIX.RectTransformDiagnosis.Name: RectTransform Diagnosis
messages.BoundedUIX.RectTransformDiagnosis.Descri: Adds a button to RectTransform components in the inspector that highlights their preferred area in the world.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Gizmos.Name: Gizmos
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Gizmos.Offset.Name: Offset
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Gizmos.Offset.Descript: Distance to raise the movement gizmos from the surface of the canvas. In world units.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Inspector.Name: Inspector
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Inspector.MoveTransfor: Move RectTransform values up when creating a parent (analog to slot transforms).
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Inspector.ParentSlotNa: Default name for parent slots in UIX hierarchies. Use {TargetName} to get the child-to-be's name.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Inspector.ChildSlotNam: Default name for child slots in UIX hierarchies. Use {TargetName} to get the parent's name.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.Inspector.PivotSlotNam: Default name for pivot slots in UIX hierarchies. Use {TargetName} to get the child-to-be's name.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.SelectableUIX.Name: Selectable UIX
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.SelectableUIX.AllowLay: Allow selecting UIX RectTransform elements that don't have anything visual on them. Helps when wanting to select layout parents using repeated selection.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.SelectableUIX.Prioriti: Prioritize the hierarchy depth of a potentially hit RectTransform over the layout order. Can help instead of or in addition to ignoring already selected elements.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.SelectableUIX.IgnoreAl: Skip already selected elements in the targeting process. Helps with layered elements.
messages.BoundedUIX.Config.SelectableUIX.RepeatSe:
The minimum local distance between targeting hits to consider it a 'new' selection attempt. Works in tandem with Ignore Already Selected.

Increase for more leniency. May need to be adjusted depending on the item.
